node.title: Re: $VERSION in module files
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: See [id://1182640|my reply] in the thread [id://1182627] that a 1.23 style versioning should provide maximum compatibility, specified in a format of our $VERSION = "1.23";. Of course, TIMTOWTDI, and you'll see [mod://Regexp::Common|some modules] use interesting versioning schemes and some modules use code to determine $VERSION like parsing it out of a VCS $Revision$ string. See the documentation in [mod://ExtUtils::MakeMaker]'s VERSION_FROM and [mod://ExtUtils::MM_Unix]'s parse_version, but note that those are probably not the only tools that parse version strings out of module files, so I'd really only recommend our $VERSION = string;.
